unit: Core theme: Knowledge and the knower
outcome: Reflect on yourself as a knower and thinker and on the communities of knowers you belong to.
Examine how technology affects the production and sharing of knowledge.
Examine the role language plays in shaping and communicating knowledge.
Examine how politics and power influence what counts as knowledge.
Examine how religious belief systems relate to knowledge and ways of knowing.
Examine how indigenous societies hold, pass on and value knowledge.

subtopic: History as an area of knowledge
outcome: Explain how historians produce knowledge, its methods, and its limits.

subtopic: Human sciences as an area of knowledge
outcome: Explain how human sciences produce knowledge about people and its limits.

subtopic: Natural sciences as an area of knowledge
outcome: Explain how natural sciences produce knowledge, their methods and limits.

subtopic: The arts as an area of knowledge
outcome: Explain how the arts create and convey knowledge and its limits.

subtopic: Mathematics as an area of knowledge
outcome: Explain how mathematical knowledge is built and justified and its limits.
